services.value: PacGenomics offers Infectious Disease Tests, Preimplantation Genetic Testing, DNA Identity Testing (including 24-hour turnaround mentioned), and Clinical Toxicology. The site also describes Sequencing Services (including Next-Generation Sequencing, Long-Read Sequencing, and Sanger Sequencing) plus STOmics and instrumentation including PCR and Liquid Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry (LCMS).
